mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan ( loan_number, customer_id, account_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, outstanding_balance, loan_status ) VALUES ( #{loanNumber}, #{customerId}, #{accountId}, #{loanType}, #{principalAmount}, #{interestRate}, #{tenureMonths}, #{outstandingBalance}, #{loanStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT loan_id, loan_number, customer_id, account_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, outstanding_balance, loan_status, approved_at, disbursed_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM loan WHERE loan_id = #{loanId}

SELECT loan_id, loan_number, customer_id, account_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, outstanding_balance, loan_status, approved_at, disbursed_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM loan WHERE loan_number = #{loanNumber}

SELECT loan_id, loan_number, customer_id, account_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, outstanding_balance, loan_status, approved_at, disbursed_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM loan WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY loan_id DESC

SELECT loan_id, loan_number, customer_id, account_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, outstanding_balance, loan_status, approved_at, disbursed_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM loan WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY loan_id DESC

SELECT loan_id, loan_number, customer_id, account_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, outstanding_balance, loan_status, approved_at, disbursed_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM loan ORDER BY loan_id DESC

SELECT loan_id, loan_number, customer_id, account_id, loan_type, principal_amount, interest_rate, tenure_months, outstanding_balance, loan_status, approved_at, disbursed_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM loan WHERE LOWER(loan_number) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY loan_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE loan SET loan_type = #{loanType}, principal_amount = #{principalAmount}, interest_rate = #{interestRate}, tenure_months = #{tenureMonths}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE loan_id = #{loanId}
UPDATE loan SET loan_status = 'APPROVED', approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} AND loan_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE loan SET loan_status = 'REJECTED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} AND loan_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE loan SET outstanding_balance = #{outstandingBalance}, loan_status = 'ACTIVE', disbursed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} AND loan_status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE loan SET outstanding_balance = #{outstandingBalance}, loan_status = #{loanStatus}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} AND loan_status = 'ACTIVE'
